neuroendocrine.label: Continuous daily everolimus · NET
additional_support: Use gentle mouth care and any prescribed alcohol-free mouthwash. Ask before buying a rinse; avoid products containing alcohol, peroxide, iodine or thyme. Report ulcers early.
Everolimus has minimal-to-low emetogenic potential. Routine premedication is not required by this regimen; agree any rescue anti-sickness or diarrhoea medicine with the team.

Existing infection must be assessed and resolved before starting. Hepatitis B testing informs any specialist prevention plan. Vaccination and any antimicrobial prevention, including PJP prevention with certain steroid plans, are individual decisions.
Report weight loss, poor intake or persistent fatigue. Ask for nutritional and symptom support; do not continue through severe symptoms simply to finish a pack.
No routine premedication is required by NCCP. No universal steroid, antimicrobial or growth-factor prescription is implied. Mouthwash and rescue treatment follow the individual prescription.

guidance.label: Use the prescribed local supportive-care plan; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
